$comment: The download page's platforms (story 60.11), in the order the page lists them; scripts/download.mjs reads it with the latest stable release. Each pattern is a regular expression over an asset's name, with {v} standing for the release's version (never a typed version). primary: the button's file, the first pattern with an asset (a later one is the fallback when an earlier leg failed); other: the other formats, each a copy key and a pattern, missing ones left out; requires: patterns every one of which must match for a card with no primary file (NAS and Docker links to its chooser); name: the card's title for a platform the copy does not name yet (the phone and TV apps); needs: the requirements line, the same words as copy/download.<lang>.md's <id>.needs; guide: the install guide or help topic, linked only once the site has built it; verify: terminal (the sha256 and a shasum command for the platform's shell) or cosign (the signed checksums.txt). appStore, testFlightPublic, googlePlay and playTestingPublic: a public store listing or testing link (owner action A6); a card with no asset and no listing is not shown. packages: the apt, dnf and Homebrew rows, shown only when the build has MAKTABA_PACKAGES_URL or HOMEBREW_TAP_REPO (owner action A7).

stores.$comment: The store links' words, for a card shown by its listing alone (A6). They live here, not in copy/download.*.md, since no page names an app before it is publicly installable (Q5; design/tests/mockups.test.mjs). The store's official badge (each store's badge rules, self-hosted as SVG in static/badges/) replaces the words with the first listing.
